description: Free public lookup for an assetId / seal / QR token. Reads matching rows from the canonical auth_seals registry when public Supabase configuration is available, and also resolves published packs. A registry match means registered only; it does not verify a signature or prove a physical item is genuine. Use verify_attestation for a published v0.1 JWS; verify_record is the separate reference-protocol verifier.

assetId.description: Seal, serial, or QR token identifier
